input.free_text_description: This system is a microservices platform that serves User, Admin roles. It manages core business objects including user. The platform provides capabilities for i user, user. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include user management functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage user records, so that I can track and organize user data effectively.
As a User, I want to interact with api base functionality, so that I can accomplish my api base-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with api functionality, so that I can accomplish my api-related tasks.
As a User, I want to interact with error functionality, so that I can accomplish my error-related tasks.
